#### SQL

```sql
SELECT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS label,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS amount,
       CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS active,
       CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS business_date,
       CAST(NULL AS TIME) AS event_time,
       CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS event_at,
       CAST(NULL AS BYTEA) AS payload,
       CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS first_flag,
       CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS last_flag,
       CAST(NULL AS SMALLINT) AS signed_le,
       CAST(NULL AS SMALLINT) AS signed_be,
       CAST(NULL AS INT UNSIGNED) AS unsigned_le,
       CAST(NULL AS INT UNSIGNED) AS unsigned_be,
       CAST(NULL AS REAL) AS ieee_le,
       CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS ieee_be,
       CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS ibm_le,
       CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS ibm_be,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(3,0)) AS trailing_sign,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(3,0)) AS leading_sign,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(3,0)) AS separate_sign,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(3,0)) AS unsigned_zone,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(3,1)) AS signed_packed,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(3,1)) AS unsigned_packed,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(3,1)) AS no_sign_packed
FROM seed
```
